_about: Terms of the +5V voltage-drop budget (MIN-2). Every value says where it comes from; ASSUMPTION means it is not from a datasheet of the part that will be fitted.

adapter.basis: USB Type-C vSafe5V floor (4.75 V). The in-box adapter is rated 5.1 V nominal, but the library has no load-regulation figure for it, so the USB-C floor is used

unknown_usb_c.basis: USB Type-C vSafe5V floor (4.75 V) for a supply the buyer chooses

adapter_captive.basis: fallback when the adapter row gives no length and gauge: 2 x 1.5 m of 18 AWG copper

usb_c_spec_max.basis: ASSUMPTION: round-trip resistance of an unknown 1 m USB-C cable chosen by the buyer

awg_basis: standard AWG table, annealed copper at 20 C

contacts_ohm.basis: ASSUMPTION: USB-C plug and receptacle VBUS and GND contacts, in and out

ptc_ohm.basis: ASSUMPTION: resistance of a 1.5 A-hold 1812 PTC after it has recovered from a trip; backplane F1 is 'PTC fuse 1.5 A hold, >= 6 V (1812)' with no part number, so no datasheet value

trace_ohm.basis: ESTIMATE: about 50 mm of 0.8 mm wide 1 oz (35 um) copper on +5V (0.61 ohm/m; backplane net_classes power_track_mm 0.8) plus about 5 mohm of GND pour; track length not measured from the routed board
